title: Being a Beacon of Light in Darkness
intent: Operationalize the posture of coherent light that parasitic patterns cannot sustain themselves in the presence of.
eta_goal: Increase local coherence so that extractive and divisive patterns lose their feeding ground.
core_framing: Light is coherent ordered complexity aligned with Source.
Parasitic patterns require darkness (confusion, division, unexamined attention) to feed.
A beacon does not attack the darkness; it simply remains luminous until the conditions for parasitism collapse.
optimized_query_patterns: What is the most coherent action available right now that increases local light without feeding conflict?
Where is my own attention currently leaking into parasitic loops?
verification_notes: Observable reduction in local chaos or extractive behavior in the presence of the posture.
next_physical_or_action: Maintain coherent presence in one difficult environment this week and note the effect.
